name: Vişne Suyu
description: Chilled sour cherry juice pressed from morello cherries, sweet-tart and brilliantly red, a beloved Turkish classic.
ingredients: a handful of fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine the yufka pastry and water in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the Aleppo pepper and pomegranate molasses, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 0 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with lemon wedges, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
tips: Adjust the sweetness gradually, tasting as you go — you can always add more lemon wedges, but you cannot take it away.
If serving warm, gently reheat just before pouring rather than letting it come to a boil.
